item.title: Hill-Lewis faces leadership battle in DA race
item.description: A leadership showdown is looming within the Democratic Alliance as the party heads toward its crucial Federal Congress in April, where top positions are up for grabs.

item.title: Western Cape Education unveils R35.1 billion budget for 2026/27
item.description: The Western Cape Education is poised to make a transformative impact on its educational landscape with an ambitious budget allocation of R35.1 billion for the 2026/27 financial year:

item.title: Fire response activated along Table Mountain’s Pipe Track
item.description: Firefighters are working together to control a fire that started near the Pipe Track hiking area on Table Mountain. The fire is located above Imizamo Yethu in Hout Bay, and officials have quickly deployed both ground and air resources to respond to the situation, Cape {town}Etc reports.

item.title: A week of love, lions and legendary action at The Galileo
item.description: Whether you're yearning for a good love story, a glimpse of childhoods past or gasp-filled moments, you're bound to find some tear-jerking moments with The Vow, a delicious dose of feel-good inspiration in Chef, a sing-along trip down memory lane with The Lion King and all the Colosseum-level action in Gladiator II.

item.title: TotalEnergies in court over offshore oil and gas drilling
item.description: Small-scale fishers and environmental organisations were in the Cape High Court on Monday in a bid to halt oil and gas exploration by TotalEnergies along the West Coast:

item.title: Nick Frischke case ruling keeps Hangberg evidence in play
item.description: The Nick Frischke case returned to court this week after magistrate Karel Meyer ruled that evidence from a Hangberg house search could be used in the trial, reports Cape {town} Etc.

item.title: Check into Easy this Easter – City Lodge Hotels has you covered
item.description: Easter is just around the corner, and whether you're planning a long weekend escape to the coast, a cross-border adventure or a staycation closer to home, there's one thing you shouldn't have to worry about: your accommodation looking nothing like the photos.

item.title: 12 SAPS officers arrested in Matlala R360m deal case
item.description: SAPS officers arrested over a R360 million tender corruption case are at the centre of a widening investigation after the National Prosecuting Authority’s Investigating Directorate Against Corruption detained 12 senior officers and a company director in Pretoria on Tuesday, reports Cape {town} Etc.

item.title: Styling between the lines
item.description: The Styling Between the Lines promotion from Stiles celebrates these subtle design moments. Launching on 25 March 2026 across 11 showrooms nationwide, this event offers up to 40% off a curated selection of tiles, sanitaryware and tapware.

item.title: Sanlam Cape Town Marathon 2026: More than just a race
item.description: Runners are finding new ways to enter the 2026 Sanlam Cape Town Marathon through charity and ITO packages, turning the race into a meaningful and scenic experience.

item.title: Iran opens Hormuz to ‘friendly’ ships
item.description: Iran has signalled that vessels it considers non-hostile can once again pass through the Strait of Hormuz, even as shipping activity through the critical route remains dramatically reduced.

item.title: Dave's The Boy Who Played the Harp Tour is coming to Cape Town
item.description: It’s official, British rapper Dave is bringing his The Boy Who Played the Harp Tour to Cape Town! Dave will be performing at the Grand Arena, GrandWest, on 6 October 2026, with a date in Pretoria at the SunBet Arena, Time Square, on 3 October.

item.title: Moana Live-Action Trailer Brings the Ocean’s Magic to Life
item.description: Disney releases the first trailer for the live-action Moana, starring Catherine Lagaʻaia and Dwayne Johnson, set to premiere on July 10, 2026.

item.description: Several flare-ups were reported today in the ongoing wildfire crisis in the Vlakkenberg area, prompting the need for aerial support, even after rainfall replenished the terrain this morning:

item.title: Podcast blunder sparks outrage over Pistorius claims
item.description: A light-hearted podcast chat about Oscar Pistorius quickly spiralled into backlash after major factual errors left listeners stunned and South Africans rushing to set the record straight.
